    Why teachers love it

    49-question assessment

    Comprehensive test covering grammar, vocabulary, reading, listening, and speaking. Adaptive difficulty based on responses.

    AI-generated profile

    Detailed learning profile with per-skill CEFR levels, strengths, weaknesses, and recommended learning path.

    4 learning paths

    Based on results, DSLM assigns one of 4 paths: Comfort, Guided, Accelerated, or Target — guiding your teaching approach.

    Speaking & listening

    Not just grammar and vocabulary — the test includes audio comprehension and speaking tasks for a complete assessment.

    How it works

    1

    Send the test link

    Generate a unique test link for your new student. They can take it on any device — phone, tablet, or computer.

    2

    Student completes 49 questions

    20-30 minutes. Questions adapt to the student's level. Grammar, vocabulary, reading, listening, and speaking sections.

    3

    AI analyzes results

    AI evaluates all answers including open-ended speaking tasks. Generates a detailed learning profile with per-skill CEFR levels.

    4

    You review the profile

    See the complete breakdown: strengths, weaknesses, confidence levels, recommended learning path. DSLM profile initialized automatically.
